title: Diffusive constituent transport
statement: Diffusion is counted adjacent-site redistribution of retained constituent labels with complete global content conservation and declared support/time recurrence.
generation_rule: Generate the literal Cartesian product of the registered content-specific carrier, relation, organization and observation choices with record, provenance, generality and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every positive finite generated Materials carrier in the registered defects_microstructure grammar that preserves labelled-constituent-carrier, adjacent-site-transition-count, global-content-conserved and time-and-support-bounded.

choices.name: carrier-erased-or-answer-only
choices.reason: Erasing the material carrier prevents reconstruction of the observed distinction.

choices.name: labelled-constituent-carrier
choices.reason: The complete generated material carrier is retained.

choices.name: relation-imported-fitted-or-erased
choices.reason: An imported, fitted or absent relation can select a familiar answer without forcing it.

choices.name: adjacent-site-transition-count
choices.reason: Only the generated constituent, adjacency, transfer or response relation is admitted.

choices.name: organization-collapsed
choices.reason: Collapsing organization merges materials states that the question requires to remain distinct.

choices.name: global-content-conserved
choices.reason: Every organization, interface, history or boundary distinction required by the claim remains held.

choices.name: observation-boundary-unrecorded
choices.reason: An unrecorded method, scale or condition cannot identify the Materials observation class.

choices.name: time-and-support-bounded
choices.reason: The exact declared observation boundary is retained and cannot select the law.

choices.name: result-without-state-transition-record
choices.reason: A result label without its state, transition and boundary trace is not auditable.

choices.name: complete-state-transition-boundary-trace
choices.reason: The complete initial state, transition, result and retained/lost distinctions are recorded.

choices.name: authority-or-target-selected-law
choices.reason: Authority, consensus, a handbook or target data may test but cannot select a Fold law.

choices.name: root-bound-forward-forcing
choices.reason: Every decision is traced through admitted dependencies to the premise-free root theorem.

choices.name: single-specimen-or-instance-lookup
choices.reason: One favorable specimen or instance does not close the generated class.

choices.name: positive-finite-successor-closure
choices.reason: The base carrier and every positive finite successor preserve the relation at the declared boundary.

choices.name: free-fit-exception-or-extra-rule
choices.reason: A free coefficient, fit, exception or added constitutive law can force a desired answer.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: No rule beyond the admitted Fold dependencies and generated preservation conditions is present.

induction_base: One complete material carrier retains its generated relation, organization, observation boundary and proof record.
induction_step: Adding one generated constituent, cell, interface, transition or observation row preserves every earlier distinction and appends its exact source-bound relation without an extra rule.
exclusions: no V1/V2 result, handbook, named material, database row, measured property or application outcome may select a survivor
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
structural absence is a held empty form and opposed direction is a held orientation, never a prohibited scalar
no axiom, free parameter, fit, learned coefficient, constitutive exception or target-derived rule
no opaque prediction, selected favorable specimen, omitted failure, or unrecorded method/condition boundary
external target content remains inaccessible until the complete prediction set is sealed

Every positive finite generated Materials carrier in the registered defects_microstructure grammar that preserves labelled-constituent-carrier, adjacent-site-transition-count, global-content-conserved and time-and-support-bounded.
operational_witnesses: the generated carrier label is held and nonempty
the generated relation and organization are separately retained
the observation boundary is distinct from the material organization
falsification_condition: The claim fails if a complete registered diffusive constituent transport observation lacks any sealed carrier, relation, organization or boundary feature, any required row is omitted, or a tampered row is accepted.
